purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and bounded safe route inspection for the WUP ranked settlement point (Ulsan).
registryBasis: Ulsan Metropolitan City’s official SmartMap publicly advertises an “연속지적도” (continuous cadastral map) layer and describes city-wide thematic map viewing. This verifies an official city cadastral map, but not accessible feature geometry or a parcel-key schema.

officialSources.observation: Official Ulsan SmartMap public page lists its continuous cadastral map layer and thematic maps; static page source was available through web rendering.
Official interactive map route; direct standard-TLS retrieval failed certificate validation, no bypass attempted.
Official city information page identifies municipal spatial-information/map services.
